motivation: Before composing finite acceleration/braking into path duration, explicitly choose where the model requires rest.

1.meaning: Require rest at each supplied intermediate waypoint, then start again.

2.meaning: Continue through collinear intermediate waypoints; require rest before direction changes and at the goal.

implementationStatus: No path-wide finite-acceleration or stop-policy implementation yet. Existing instantaneous path-time proxy stays unchanged.
scope: A proposed virtual-model design decision, not an established physical robot behavior or universal best controller. Record the actual choice/reason before implementation; keep alternate assumptions explicit.
